contract: The app lends this Mac through trios-host join and shows what the host's work used and what the public ledger credits it. Every rule is gHashTag/t27 specs/hosting/panel.t27, generated to C by make hosting-card and imported as a Clang module; Swift holds views and I/O only.
red: Card negative controls (8 + 1), each FAIL by name in t27c test-report: size not checked, the Queen's host boundary dropped, toggle-off skipping stopping, a refused receipt counted as agreed, no leaf read as not verified, settlement ignored by the disclaimer, every host's rows tallied, a failure after registration not a lapse, a key file readable by others called private.

Swift negative controls in make hosting-test: the tally given no host id, the last partial line dropped, no pin check before start (each FAIL), and no SIGKILL after the grace (the test hangs and the 60 s alarm kills it).

green.card: t27c test-report 18/18, 0 vacuous; pinned t27b 18/18; the generated C's own runner prints All 18 tests passed.
green.swift: make hosting-test: All hosting panel tests passed.
green.build: make dev: dev app built, 0 compiler warnings; make sources-drift and make parse-tests pass.
green.local_run: DEV app with TRIOS_HOST_HOME=~/.trios-host-owner registered with https://api.t27.ai as host 57c4f5d613622106, tier owner, 1 slot, isolation job-dir-only; the ledger showed 0 mTRI and probation 0 of 10; the epoch 0 statement had no leaf for this host.

lessons: A gen-c file imported whole as a module header links twice under -O: swiftc emits the bodies of the C functions it calls. The header is the generated file cut at the Function implementations banner.
A card constant named EV_RECEIPT collides with <sys/event.h> in every Swift file that also imports Darwin. Name card constants so no system header holds them.

gen-c resolves `use` lazily against the nearest specs/ directory, but a module imported whole (network/mvp.t27 imports queen::actors) drags a large closure; import from modules that import nothing when the card is vendored.
Screen capture from the agent's shell is refused (no Screen Recording grant); the Claude terminal tab has it.
